newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar little changed in routine trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar little changed in routine trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was close to unchanged in routine business, traders said.
By 1650 GMT front month August was 20 cents higher, at $312.40. August volume was 913 lots of a total 1,025.
There was reasonable buying from the trade, but with no surprises in fundamental news, there was nothing to trigger any sharp moves, one said.
"It's all pretty well coming out as it should," he said of fundamental news.

And with the focus in traders' minds on New York and liquidating the high open interest in May ahead of the contract's expiry after Wednesday's close, London was to some extent sidelined, traders said.

In fundamental news, Brazilian 1997/98 sugar production should reach 13.48 million tonnes, of which 5.39 million will be available for exports, according to the government's crop plan published today in the official gazette. Traders expected little impact from the figures.
